audience: sales and support teams with Getfly CRM API access

useCases.title: Review sales opportunities
useCases.text: List opportunities in a campaign and inspect their current stages and discussion comments.

useCases.title: Find unpaid sales orders
useCases.text: List sales orders for the requested period and inspect payment status, amounts and line items.

useCases.title: Create a requested follow-up task
useCases.text: Find the customer and intended assignee, then create a follow-up task when requested. Getfly may notify the assignee.

useCases.title: Move an opportunity to another stage
useCases.text: Check the opportunity and available campaign stages, then move it to the requested stage.
